name: Cumbria Community Foundation Jeffrey Bond Memorial Fund
summary: Small grants to charitable and not-for-profit groups for nature conservation work in Cumbria, such as habitat creation and restoration, species conservation and hedge restoration, with priority for projects that involve volunteers.
reporting: Submit monitoring information via the online grant monitoring form, including outcomes, indicators, quantitative and qualitative data, and evidence of spend such as receipts and timesheets.

eligibility.rule: The supported work must be legally charitable
Have a management committee with at least three unrelated members
Have an organisation account with at least two unrelated bank signatories
Provide signed annual accounts and an independent examination over £25,000 income
Have charitable aims evidenced by the governing document
Register with the Charity Commission in England or Wales over £5,000 annual income
Have a registered address or local voluntary committee or trustees in Cumbria unless the fund permits otherwise
Project activities must not have already started

administered_by.quote: Cumbria Community Foundation is a charitable company limited by guarantee.

applicant_types.quote: Who can apply? • charitable, not-for-profit groups

geography.quote: Grants to organisations to support nature conservation and the environment in Cumbria.

access.quote: All applications are now made through our online application portal

amount.quote: Grants will normally be up to £2,000 over one year.

reporting.quote: All grant recipients are required to submit monitoring information on their projects

effort.quote: applications are checked for eligibility and assessed against the fund's priorities.
